The hedge fund held 8,462 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.90M, up from 5,877 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Eagle Global Advisors Llc who had been investing in Amazon Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $770.06 billion market cap company. (NASDAQ:AMZN) has risen 76.78% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 65.23% the S&P500.
